subject: Service accounting discrepancy and remedial credit request — Velociti
messages:
From: Rajesh Gupta <rajesh.gupta@velociti.com>

Cc: accounts@velociti.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected availability variance — request for accounting and remedial credit

Naomi,

Hope you’re well. Our SRE team flagged an availability dip in US-WEST-2 that affected Velociti checkout traffic overnight (approx window below). We see a ~7.8% availability shortfall vs. our contracted SLO for the 02:00–04:45 UTC window on 2026-11-29. That translated to a measurable revenue impact for our checkout flow and several timed-out requests.

Could you confirm you see the same window on your side and provide the following as soon as possible:
- Verified downtime/partial-availability window (UTC)
- Raw traces/telemetry bundle for the window (aggregated and per-shard if possible)
- A preliminary credit estimate or the approach you’ll use to calculate it

We’re preparing a customer-impact summary (volume, failed transactions) but would like Redwood’s confirmation before we escalate formally with finance.

Attachments: none on our side yet — will share impact CSV once available.

Thanks,
Rajesh Gupta
Senior SRE, Velociti

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: naomi.feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: (internal SRE oncall)
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:18:02 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Unexpected availability variance — request for accounting and remedial credit

Naomi — pulled traces and ran a quick aggregation. Summary below (see attachments for full artifacts).

Preliminary SRE summary (high level):
- Verified partial-availability window (UTC): 2026-11-29 02:08:00 — 2026-11-29 04:53:30 UTC (2h 45m 30s).
- Symptoms: elevated 503 responses and increased p95/p99 latency; high queue length on the frontend pool for the checkout model route.
- Root cause (initial): autoscaler misconfiguration during an internal scaling event caused delayed pool refill for the checkout serving group in US-WEST-2. Not a model regression; an orchestration edge case where instance health checks were mis-evaluated and nodes were not added fast enough.
- Fallbacks: route-level fallback to a lower-capacity variant was attempted but overflowed for the busiest tenants during peak minutes (confirmed by increased 503 and client-side timeouts).

Attachments included:
- usw2_trace_20261129.zip (raw traces by shard, 120MB)
- latency_summary_20261129.csv (minute-level p50/p95/p99 and 5xx/4xx counts)

Suggested accounting approach: prorated credit based on partial-availability minutes per tenant weighted by request volume during the window. For Velociti, we recommend using their supplied failed-transaction CSV as the primary signal and cross-checking against our per-tenant call counts.

Next steps: Laura to draft credit memo; Naomi to confirm final window with Velociti and agree share of telemetry for reconciliation. I’ll prepare a short RCA and postmortem invite after we stabilize the rollback plan.

—David
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Unexpected availability variance — request for accounting and remedial credit

Rajesh — thanks for the patience. We’ve completed an initial verification.

Verified window (Redwood): 2026-11-29 02:08:00 — 2026-11-29 04:53:30 UTC
(We expanded ±15min on either side for telemetry bleed; David’s attached CSV is minute-granular.)

Preliminary approach to credit:
- Use Velociti’s failed-transactions CSV as the primary impact signal, reconciled against Redwood per-tenant request counts.
- Apply prorated credit proportional to percentage shortfall in availability for that tenant during the verified window.
- As a provisional figure, and pending reconciliation, we intend to propose a credit equal to 2.5% of Velociti’s November 2026 invoice (this is conservative; final number will reflect the reconciliation).

Action items we’ll take now:
1) Laura will produce a draft credit memo (attached as PDF) and a DocuSign link for approval.
2) We’ll schedule a short alignment call to reconcile numbers — can you do 2026-12-01 10:00–10:30 PT? If not, propose two alternatives.
3) We’ll share the internal RCA draft and postmortem invite once we have the full SRE timeline.

Attachments: usw2_trace_20261129.zip (attached by SRE), latency_summary_20261129.csv, credit-memo-draft-velociti.pdf (draft from billing).

Please confirm the reconciliation call time and whether you’re okay with our provisional credit approach.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
